title: The Zigzag
hook: It climbs to us. The stones are sliding.
synopsis: The Hush is faster in the valley. Rook takes the old zigzag line up the steep face of Iron Mountain, where the loose stones slide under its feet.
note: The last train runs again tomorrow.
lines: The valley lamps went dark. It's here!
It's faster down here. Hold the bar!
Iron Mountain! We take the old zigzag.
Rails go where feet can't. Up we go!
Switch one! Now backwards, up the next!
Look! The stones slide under it!
It's climbing again. Higher this time...
We're slipping back! The rails are wet!
Sand on the rails! Full steam!
It slid all the way down!
High Gate! Everyone inside, it's warm!
It's still looking up. It will be back.
